summary: Move the mark operators into the data (`exists_move_markOperator` with L = Λ) and apply `gaugeLe_chain`.

steps.claim: For each j: t_j with (a), (b), (c) of `exists_move_markOperator` for L = Λ.
steps.lean: choose t A B C using (H.exists_move_markOperator hQ hΛ · Λ.attach.nodup_toList)

steps.claim: The chain with data t_j(translateDatum x j) applied to v equals the original chain applied to Y^j v (induction on j with (b)).
steps.lean:
have k x (h : x ∈ Ψ.support) j : chain (D.liftKernel ϑ) (fun j ↦ t j (D.translateDatum x j)) j v =
    chain (D.liftKernel ϑ) (D.translateDatum x) j (((Λ.attach.toList.map hΛ.markOperator).prod ^ j)
    v) := j.rec rfl fun j i ↦ by simp [pow_succ', ← B j x h, ← i]; rfl
steps.typed_fact:
chain (D.liftKernel ϑ) (fun j ↦ t j (D.translateDatum x j)) j v =
    chain (D.liftKernel ϑ) (D.translateDatum x) j (((Λ.attach.toList.map hΛ.markOperator).prod ^ j)
    v)

steps.claim: By `GaugeLe.restrictToY` (p ≠ N) it suffices to bound the chain combination.
`gaugeLe_chain` with the t_j (they commute with the levels, (a)), d = 1 and r_j = #Λδ_p + liftLoss(Λ, j) from (c) at g = 1, for the integral v; rewrite with step 2.
steps.lean:
simpa +contextual [Finsupp.sum, k, -sum_add_distrib] using! H.gaugeLe_chain hQ t (by
    simp +contextual [A, (D.isLevel_columnLevel.1 ·)]) 1 (fun x h j ↦ by
    simpa [← Nat.cast_sum, sum_attach, -List.map_subtype] using C j x h 1) hv.2
